beats.vo: If your body won't cooperate your first time, trying harder makes it worse.
beats.visual_intent: Pressure gauge close-up, needle dropping, high contrast, no people.

beats.vo: Your body responds when you feel relaxed, not when you force it. Stress pushes it the other way.
beats.visual_intent: Dim room, one soft light, calm, no people.

beats.vo: That's why nerves hit guys hardest the first time. You're flooded with stress, and the more you worry about it working, the harder it is for it to work.
beats.visual_intent: Storm clouds moving fast, time-lapse, dark.

beats.vo: Telling yourself to relax doesn't fix it either. What helps is changing what's riding on the night.
beats.visual_intent: Tight knot in a rope, close-up.

beats.vo: Nothing has to happen tonight for it to count. You can kiss, talk, slow down, stop, and pick it up another time.
beats.visual_intent: Open empty road at golden hour, no cars.

beats.vo: So take the pressure off the night. It doesn't have to go any particular way.
